DESCRIPTION: Shared base rule (every owner). Normalized scam links (lowercase host, no www, no http/https, no trailing slash, tracking query parameters removed; t.me/telegram.me paths lowercased and a leading @ removed; api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=N -> wa.me/N). An exact Telegram/WhatsApp/Zangi link match is enough to auto-block (a 'Zangi 3415158270' number in a bio is stored as services.zangi.com/dl/3415158270); any other watchlisted link auto-blocks together with an existing lure or impersonation feature. An entry without a path matches the whole domain. Entries: domain, url, kind, source, first_seen_handle, added.
PROSE_AUTOLINK_IGNORE_WHY: Words in a bio that X turned into a link but that are not a destination the account points to (e.g. 'Not here to fit in.Here to build', 'X Corp and X.Al. Neuralink'). Skipped by known-list ingest.
